description: This file defines the TradeListViewModel class, which manages trade data for a trade list screen in an Android application. It handles loading, filtering, searching, deleting trades, and retrieving trade dates. It interacts with a TradeRepository to access trade data and maintains observable LiveData for UI updates.

classes.name: TradeListViewModel
classes.description: An Android ViewModel for managing trade list data, including loading, filtering, searching, and deleting trades from a repository.

methods.name: loadTrades
methods.description: Loads all trades from the database, optionally filtered by status.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets the trade status filter and reloads the trade list.

methods.name: searchTrades
methods.description: Searches trades by a query string.

methods.name: deleteTrade
methods.description: Deletes a trade by its ID and refreshes the trade list.

methods.name: loadTradesForDate
methods.description: Loads trades for a specific date.

methods.name: getTradeDates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of trade dates for calendar purposes.
